title.en: Ibrahim (AS): The Fire That Turned Cool
title.hi: Ibrahim (AS): Woh Aag Jo Thandi Ho Gayi

status: draft: to be checked by a scholar before public release

say.en: A whole people lit a fire for one young man, because he would not bow to their idols. And then Allah spoke to the fire.
say.hi: Ek poori qaum ne ek naujawan ke liye aag jalayi, kyunki woh unke buton ke aage nahi jhuka. Aur phir Allah ne aag se baat ki.

say.en: The Quran says: Allah had given Ibrahim his sound judgement, and Allah knew him well.
say.hi: Quran kehta hai: Allah ne Ibrahim ko pehle hi sahi samajh di thi, aur Allah unhein khoob jaanta tha.

say.en: He asked his father and his people: What are these statues you are so devoted to? They said: We found our fathers worshipping them.
say.hi: Unhone apne baap aur apni qaum se poocha: yeh kya moortiyan hain jinke aage tum jame baithe ho? Unhone kaha: humne apne baap dadaon ko inki ibadat karte paaya.

say.en: He said: Your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the One who created them. And to that, I am a witness.
say.hi: Unhone kaha: tumhara Rabb aasmanon aur zameen ka Rabb hai, jisne unhein paida kiya. Aur main iska gawah hoon.

heading.en: BY ALLAH, | *I WILL PLAN AGAINST THEM*

say.en: And he swore: By Allah, I will plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away.
say.hi: Aur unhone qasam khayi: Allah ki qasam, jab tum chale jaoge, main tumhare buton ke saath ek tadbeer karunga.

heading.hi: SAB TUKDE TUKDE, | *SIWAYE SABSE BADE KE*

say.en: So he broke them into pieces, all except the largest one, so that they might turn back to it.
say.hi: To unhone sab ko tukde tukde kar diya, siwaye sabse bade ke, taake log usi ki taraf ruju karein.

heading.hi: HAMARE KHUDAON KE SAATH | *YEH KISNE KIYA?*

say.en: They said: Who has done this to our gods? Some said: We heard a young man speak of them. He is called Ibrahim.
say.hi: Woh bole: hamare khudaon ke saath yeh kisne kiya? Kuch ne kaha: humne ek naujawan ko inka zikr karte suna hai, jise Ibrahim kehte hain.

heading.en: SO ASK THEM, | *IF THEY CAN SPEAK*
heading.hi: TO INHI SE POOCHHO, | *AGAR YEH BOLTE HAIN*

say.en: They asked him before the people: Did you do this to our gods, O Ibrahim? He said: Rather, this biggest one did it. So ask them, if they can speak.
say.hi: Logon ke saamne unse poocha: Ibrahim, kya tumne hamare khudaon ke saath yeh kiya? Unhone kaha: balke is bade ne kiya hai. To inhi se poochh lo, agar yeh bolte hain.

say.en: They turned to themselves and said: Truly, you are the wrongdoers. Then they turned back again: You know these do not speak.
say.hi: Woh apne dil ki taraf palte aur bole: asal zaalim to tum ho. Phir ulte palat gaye: tum to jaante ho ke yeh bolte nahi.

say.en: He said: Then do you worship, instead of Allah, what cannot benefit you at all, or harm you? Will you not use reason?
say.hi: Unhone kaha: to kya tum Allah ko chhod kar unki ibadat karte ho jo tumhein na zara faida de sakein na nuqsan? Kya tum aql se kaam nahi lete?

heading.hi: ISE JALA DO! | *APNE KHUDAON KI MADAD KARO*

say.en: They said: Burn him, and support your gods, if you are going to act.
say.hi: Woh bole: ise jala do, aur apne khudaon ki madad karo, agar tumhein kuch karna hai.

heading.en: HIS WORDS | *AS HE WAS THROWN IN*
heading.hi: AAG MEIN DAALE JAATE WAQT | *UNKE ALFAAZ*

say.en: Ibn Abbas said: when Ibrahim was thrown into the fire, he said: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil. Allah is enough for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
say.hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: jab Ibrahim ko aag mein daala gaya to unhone kaha: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil. Hamare liye Allah kaafi hai, aur woh behtareen kaarsaaz hai.

heading.hi: AYE AAG, | *THANDI AUR SALAMATI BAN JA*

say.en: And Allah said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.
say.hi: Aur Allah ne farmaya: aye aag, Ibrahim par thandi aur salamati wali ban ja.

say.en: They wanted to harm him, but Allah made them the greatest losers.
say.hi: Unhone unhein nuqsan pahunchana chaha, magar Allah ne unhi ko sabse zyada ghaate wala bana diya.

say.en: When the fire in front of you feels too big, say what Ibrahim said: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil. Allah is enough for you.
say.hi: Jab saamne ki aag bahut badi lage, to wohi kehna jo Ibrahim ne kaha: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil. Aapke liye Allah kaafi hai.

heading.en: SEND THIS TO SOMEONE | *FACING A FIRE TODAY*
heading.hi: YEH USAY BHEJEIN | *JO AAJ AAG KE SAAMNE HAI*

say.en: Send this to someone who is facing a fire of their own today.
say.hi: Yeh video usay bhejein, jo aaj apni kisi aag ka saamna kar raha hai.
